newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan Bourse indices hit new historic highs.
newsitem.headline: Milan Bourse indices hit new historic highs.

text.p: The Milan stock market's all-share Mibtel index, Mib30 blue chip index and the Fib30 bourse index future all hit new historic highs in Monday afternoon trading, dealers said.
The Mibtel index rose nearly 0.7 percent to 13,276 after a previous record at 13,239 set on Friday.
The Mib30 index touched 20,179 against a previous record of 20,155 and the Fib September contract, replacing June from Friday, touched a high of 20,430.
